title: Περὶ τῶν ἀρεσκόντων τοῖς φιλοσόφοις — [Plutarch], Placita philosophorum (Aëtius epitome); RU «О мнениях философов»
author: Aëtius, in the Pseudo-Plutarch epitome
date: Aëtius 1st c. CE; epitome c. 150 CE
edition: Diels, Doxographi Graeci (1879), public domain: https://archive.org/details/doxographigraec00dielgoog. Mansfeld and Runia, Aëtiana V (2020), copyrighted.
ru_evidence: No complete Russian version found (CyberLeninka: 'Плациты', 'Аэций доксограф'; archive.org). Individual testimonia appear in Presocratic collections (Lebedev, ФРГФ 1989).
en_evidence: Mansfeld and Runia, Aëtiana V: edition, translation and commentary of the reconstructed Placita (Brill 2020), per Open Library.
other_translations: French: Lachenaud, Budé (1993), not verified in this sweep. Others: unknown.
value: The backbone of ancient doxography: a systematic survey of physical opinions from Thales to the Stoics, and the source of many DK A-testimonia. Essential for teaching and research on early Greek philosophy and science; the Russian Presocratic-studies community is strong.
ai_feasibility: High. Terse, formulaic sentences. Care needed with attributions and the Stobaean parallel tradition. Public-domain Diels text.
pilot_unit: Book II (cosmos, heavens, sun, moon), about 6k words (estimate).
